_source: rusthelp.com/tools/techtree embedded data — real in-game node positions, costs, prereqs.

nodes.name: Hot Air Balloon Armor
nodes.desc: Armor for the Hot Air Balloon

nodes.name: Boat Building Station
nodes.desc: A deployable building station, creates a stable workspace on the water to build or edit your floating wooden refuge.

nodes.name: Boat Building Plan
nodes.desc: A boat plan. You can use this to craft boats - right click when equipped for more options.

nodes.name: Steering Wheel
nodes.desc: A lockable steering wheel for your modular boat with some suspiciously shaped handles.

nodes.name: Satchel Charge
nodes.desc: Small explosive package constructed of beancan grenades. Useful for destroying wood and sheet metal doors.

nodes.name: Flame Turret
nodes.desc: Automated Flame turret. Requires Low Grade Fuel. Sprays flames when triggered.

nodes.name: Tuna Can Lamp
nodes.desc: A makeshift wall light. Still smells faintly of fish.

nodes.name: Rug
nodes.desc: A decorative rug that can be placed on walls, floors, and ceilings. Provides comfort when in close proximity.

nodes.name: Large Wooden Sign
nodes.desc: A 3-meter by 1.5-meter wooden sign that you can write on.

nodes.name: Bear Skin Rug
nodes.desc: A decorative rug that can be placed on walls, floors, and ceilings. Provides comfort when in close proximity.

nodes.name: Huge Wooden Sign
nodes.desc: A 6-meter by 3-meter wooden sign that you can write on.

nodes.name: Spinning Wheel
nodes.desc: An interactive spinning wheel.

nodes.name: Drop Box
nodes.desc: This item can be deployed on walls so that players can input items from the exterior of the building for safe keeping. You can only access the submitted contents of the Drop Box from the rear.

nodes.name: Tank Top
nodes.desc: A tank top, comes with free stains. Basic protection, but better than nothing.

nodes.name: Shirt
nodes.desc: A smart casual shirt. Might make you look more trustworthy. Moderate clothing for protection against damage and the elements.

nodes.name: T-Shirt
nodes.desc: A tshirt, simple undergarment. Good protection from damage and the elements.

nodes.name: Shorts
nodes.desc: Trusty pair of shorts, may provide a breeze in undesired places. Worse than their full length counterparts with only basic protection from damage and the elements.

nodes.name: Salvaged Hammer
nodes.desc: A Hammer made from a bunch of other crap.

nodes.name: Pants
nodes.desc: A pair of pants, highly capable undergarment for your legs. Great all round protection from damage and the elements.

nodes.name: Salvaged Sword
nodes.desc: A powerful melee weapon made from a filed-down wrench. Great durability, good damage.

nodes.name: Pickaxe
nodes.desc: A Pickaxe, useful for gathering ore from rocks.

nodes.name: Engineering Workbench
nodes.desc: This allows you to craft and unlock electrical, water and industrial items

nodes.name: Reinforced Wooden Shield
nodes.desc: A basic wooden shield with added protection, keeps you safe but not for long. Usable with single handed weapons and tools.

nodes.name: Mini Crossbow
nodes.desc: A very accurate ranged weapon with a rotating barrel.

nodes.name: Mace
nodes.desc: A powerful 2-handed melee weapon, It's unique design makes it easier to hit your target when compared to other more traditional weapons.

nodes.name: Revolver
nodes.desc: A standard eight shot revolver.

nodes.name: Flare
nodes.desc: Light up the night sky with this brand new red flare!

nodes.name: Pistol Bullet
nodes.desc: Ammunition for a Pistol. Loses velocity when fired over long distances resulting in slightly decreased damage.

nodes.name: Hatchet
nodes.desc: A Hatchet, useful for chopping trees and dismembering corpses.

nodes.name: Wooden Barricade Cover
nodes.desc: Perfect for cover when engaging in gun fights. Decays rapidly when placed outside of building privilege.

nodes.name: Wooden Ladder
nodes.desc: A ladder will help you climb walls in any base.

nodes.name: Wooden Barricade
nodes.desc: A wooden barricade. Will hurt players and animals that run into it.

nodes.name: Stone Barricade
nodes.desc: A protective barricade made out of Stones.

nodes.name: Barbed Wooden Barricade
nodes.desc: A wooden barricade with barbed wire, made of Wood and Metal Fragments. The barbed wire causes damage and will also slow player movement.

nodes.name: Sandbag Barricade
nodes.desc: A protective barricade made out of Sand Bags.

nodes.name: Wooden Floor Spikes
nodes.desc: A set of spikes that will slow down and hurt anyone that walks over them.

nodes.name: Chainlink Fence
nodes.desc: A Chainlink Fence.

nodes.name: Compound Bow
nodes.desc: A very powerful bow. Can only be fully drawn while stationary. Keep still for bonus damage and speed.

nodes.name: Snap Trap
nodes.desc: A metal trap that can injure or even kill people when stepped on. Can be picked up after been triggered.

nodes.name: Wood Shutters
nodes.desc: Wood shutters that you can open and close.

nodes.name: Watch Tower
nodes.desc: A high wooden watchtower with a ladder

nodes.name: Tin Can Alarm
nodes.desc: A primitive perimeter alarm made from hanging tin cans. Clatters loudly when disturbed, alerting you to any trespassers. Can be rigged with grenades or other throwables.

nodes.name: Metal Window Bars
nodes.desc: Metal window bars made to fit a normal sized window.

nodes.name: High External Wooden Wall
nodes.desc: A high wooden wall used to keep people off your property.

nodes.name: High External Wooden Gate
nodes.desc: A high wooden gate, allowing access in and out of your compound.

nodes.name: Siege Tower
nodes.desc: A rolling siege tower, providing cover and access to enemy bases. Can be locked with your own door. Can be towed by horses.

nodes.name: Chainlink Fence Gate
nodes.desc: A Chainlink Fence Gate.

nodes.name: Floor grill
nodes.desc: A floor grill must be placed in floor frames. Perfect for placing above a large furnace.

nodes.name: Floor triangle grill
nodes.desc: A floor grill must be placed in floor frames. Perfect for placing above a large furnace.

nodes.name: Salvaged Cleaver
nodes.desc: A powerful 2-handed melee weapon with high damage.

nodes.name: Waterpipe Shotgun
nodes.desc: A Shotgun. Fires a single round before reloading.

nodes.name: Double Barrel Shotgun
nodes.desc: A Shotgun with two barrels allowing two shots to be fired in quick succession before needing to reload.

nodes.name: Combat Knife
nodes.desc: Combat knife designed for close combat engagements, can attack while sprinting. Best in class at harvesting flesh.

nodes.name: Binoculars
nodes.desc: Binoculars allowing you to see objects at great length.

nodes.name: Shotgun Trap
nodes.desc: A shotgun trap triggered by movement, place near doorways and load with handmade shells.

nodes.name: Weapon flashlight
nodes.desc: Attaches to a weapon. Provides user with a beam of light. Pressing F (default) to toggle light.

nodes.name: Soda Can Silencer
nodes.desc: Significantly reduces the sound of gunfire, and completely removes any visible muzzle flash. Crudely made out of a soda can, this will only survive a few shots.

nodes.name: Fire Arrow
nodes.desc: A fuel soaked arrow, ignite it by aiming.

nodes.name: Handmade SMG
nodes.desc: An extremely basic automatic firearm. Low damage and accuracy.

nodes.name: Beancan Grenade
nodes.desc: An unreliable explosive grenade. Each one has a different length fuse, so you might lose some fingers. Can be used to make satchel charges.

nodes.name: Beenie Hat
nodes.desc: A wooly hat, offering some basic protection from damage and cold for your head.

nodes.name: Improvised Balaclava
nodes.desc: A makeshift balaclava. Cost effective protection from the cold, but unremarkable at preventing melee and projectile damage.

nodes.name: Longsleeve T-Shirt
nodes.desc: Long sleeve tshirt, versatile clothing for protection against damage and the elements.

nodes.name: Miners Hat
nodes.desc: A leather cap with a flashlight attached. It uses Low Grade Fuel and can be activated from the inventory.

nodes.name: Riot Helmet
nodes.desc: A makeshift riot Helmet. Great at deflecting melee attacks.

nodes.name: Snow Jacket
nodes.desc: A thick, high visibility Jacket. It will help keep you warm in any climate.

nodes.name: Jacket
nodes.desc: A rugged jacket, will help keep you warm. High cold protection but incompatible with other chest attire.

nodes.name: Wooden Armor Insert
nodes.desc: Wood insert for crafted clothes and armor, provides some extra protection from bullets and melee.

nodes.name: Prisoner Hood
nodes.desc: A hood for prisoners, restricts vision.

nodes.name: Water Bucket
nodes.desc: A bucket for transporting water or other liquids.

nodes.name: Bucket Helmet
nodes.desc: A Bucket Helmet. It provides a level of regional protection from inflicted damage.

nodes.name: Chair
nodes.desc: Every home needs a chair. A decorative item which provides comfort while seated.

nodes.name: Mail Box
nodes.desc: A Mailbox that accepts notes. Only you can access the mail due to a one way slit.

nodes.name: Large Planter Box
nodes.desc: A large planter with enough room to plant 9 seeds.

nodes.name: Salvaged Shelves
nodes.desc: Shelves for item stacking

nodes.name: Bed
nodes.desc: A Bed. Placing this will give you a place to respawn and can be used much more frequently than a sleeping bag. Note: Must be placed inside a building.

nodes.name: Stone Fireplace
nodes.desc: A stone fireplace to heat your home. Must be placed indoors and against a wall.

nodes.name: Table
nodes.desc: Every home needs a table. A decorative item which provides comfort when in close proximity.

nodes.name: Triangle Planter Box
nodes.desc: A triangle planter with enough room to plant 4 seeds.

nodes.name: Chicken Coop
nodes.desc: An enclosure to keep some chickens around. Chickens with plenty of food, water and sunlight produce more eggs.

nodes.name: Beehive
nodes.desc: Hand made beehive, place a nucleus inside to raise your own bees and produce honeycomb. Happy bees will make honeycomb more quickly.

nodes.name: Mixing Table
nodes.desc: Used for mixing recipes.

nodes.name: Bee Grenade
nodes.desc: A fragile glass jar full of bees. Breaking upon impact, the bees will find the nearest player to attack. Careful where you throw it!

nodes.name: Paddle
nodes.desc: A versatile melee weapon that can also be used to paddle a kayak.

nodes.name: Kayak
nodes.desc: An improvised wooden kayak. Seats two and requires a Paddle to operate.

nodes.name: Speargun
nodes.desc: A speargun which can only be fired underwater. Excellent for hunting Sharks.

nodes.name: Speargun Spear
nodes.desc: Ammunition for a speargun.

nodes.name: Sail
nodes.desc: A slow but effective boat sail, made from scraps of fabric hastily stitched together. More sails will generate more speed.

nodes.name: Anchor
nodes.desc: A heavy anchor to stop your boat drifting.

nodes.name: Plank
nodes.desc: Crude boarding plank thrown together from ruined floorboards, watch out for splinters.

nodes.name: Small Ramp
nodes.desc: Deployable wooden ramp cobbled together from recycled doors, probably sturdy enough. Unfolds for boarding enemy vessels.

nodes.name: Cannon
nodes.desc: A heavy mountable cannon for your boat with a short fuse. Questionable accuracy but high damage.

nodes.name: Cannonball
nodes.desc: Round solid ammo for the cannon

nodes.name: Clan Table
nodes.desc: A table for managing clans.

nodes.name: Hazmat Suit
nodes.desc: A hazmat suit made from radiation resistant rubber.

nodes.name: Longsword
nodes.desc: A powerful 2-handed melee weapon with good range and high damage.

nodes.name: Large Medkit
nodes.desc: A large medkit that heals you to max health over time and stops any bleeding instantly.\n\nGuarantees 100% recovery from the wounded state if placed in your toolbar.

nodes.name: Medical Syringe
nodes.desc: Heal yourself or others with this syringe. Left-click heals you, right-click heals a target.

nodes.name: Boots
nodes.desc: Sturdy work boots to keep your toes safe, you'd feel nothing if you kicked a table leg. Strong protection against the cold and incoming damage.

nodes.name: Road Sign Jacket
nodes.desc: A shoddy piece of body armor made from roadsigns.

nodes.name: Hoodie
nodes.desc: A hoodie.

nodes.name: Coffee Can Helmet
nodes.desc: A Coffee Can Helmet. It provides a level of regional protection from inflicted damage.

nodes.name: Road Sign Kilt
nodes.desc: A shoddy piece of leg armor made from roadsigns. Moderate protection from melee and projectiles.

nodes.name: Road Sign Gloves
nodes.desc: Gloves made out of metal, offer a good amount of protection to the upper body.

nodes.name: Homemade Landmine
nodes.desc: Homemade Landmine. If you stand on one, you can ask a friend to disarm it before it explodes.

nodes.name: Pump Shotgun
nodes.desc: A Shotgun. Fires 8 rounds.

nodes.name: Semi-Automatic Pistol
nodes.desc: A semi-automatic pistol, fires rapidly and with good accuracy.

nodes.name: F1 Grenade
nodes.desc: A reliable military grenade that can be thrown a short distance. Deadly at close range on detonation.

nodes.name: Python Revolver
nodes.desc: A High Powered six-shooter.

nodes.name: Battering Ram
nodes.desc: A reinforced siege weapon built for smashing through wooden and stone constructions with brute force. Must be repaired with high quality metal to keep functioning.

nodes.name: Oil Filter Silencer
nodes.desc: Significantly reduces the sound of gunfire, and completely removes any visible muzzle flash. Fashioned out of an old oil filter, this won't last long.

nodes.name: Ballista
nodes.desc: A stationary ballista, perfect for defence. Can fire deadly bolts at distant targets.

nodes.name: Pitchfork Bolt
nodes.desc: A wide-impact bolt for a ballista, covering a large area while dealing moderate damage.

nodes.name: Catapult
nodes.desc: An improvised catapult siege weapon. Built for flinging destructive projectiles with questionable accuracy. Can be towed by horses.

nodes.name: Scattershot
nodes.desc: A cluster of heavy rock projectiles for a catapult. Wide spread, pure kinetic damage on impact.

nodes.name: Flame Thrower
nodes.desc: A Flamethrower. Uses low grade fuel as ammunition.

nodes.name: Firebomb
nodes.desc: A crude firebomb made of fuel-filled jugs wrapped in a net. Can be placed or used as a projectile in a catapult.

nodes.name: Muzzle Boost
nodes.desc: Increases weapon fire rate by channeling gasses back into the weapon cycling it faster, at the cost of bullet accuracy.

nodes.name: Custom SMG
nodes.desc: A rapid-firing Machine Gun. Sacrifices accuracy and distance for speed.

nodes.name: Salvaged Axe
nodes.desc: A high-yield resource gathering axe. Slower than the Hatchet.

nodes.name: Muzzle Brake
nodes.desc: Lowers recoil felt by the operator but can make bullet path more unpredictable and dealing slightly less damage to your foes.

nodes.name: Thompson
nodes.desc: A medium damage machine gun.

nodes.name: Salvaged Icepick
nodes.desc: A high-yield resource gathering Icepick.

nodes.name: Metal horizontal embrasure
nodes.desc: Static shutter that forms a metal horizontal embrasure over your window frame.

nodes.name: Prison Cell Gate
nodes.desc: A prison cell gate to lock things behind bars

nodes.name: Metal Shield
nodes.desc: A large sturdy metal shield, keeps arrows and bullets at bay. Usable with single handed weapons and tools.

nodes.name: 12 Gauge Buckshot
nodes.desc: Ammunition for a Shotgun.

nodes.name: Metal Vertical embrasure
nodes.desc: Static shutter that forms a metal vertical embrasure over your window frame.

nodes.name: Prison Cell Wall
nodes.desc: A prison cell wall.

nodes.name: Concrete Barricade
nodes.desc: A barricade made out of Stones.

nodes.name: Metal Barricade
nodes.desc: A tough metal barricade with barbed wire, made from Metal Fragments. The barbed wire causes damage and will also slow player movement.

nodes.name: 12 Gauge Slug
nodes.desc: Single large projectile for a Shotgun.

nodes.name: 12 Gauge Incendiary Shell
nodes.desc: Incendiary Shotgun Ammunition

nodes.name: Strengthened Glass Window
nodes.desc: Strengthened Glass Window

nodes.name: Molotov Cocktail
nodes.desc: A glass bottle filled with low grade fuel. Smashes and spreads fire when it lands, incredibly high damage to wood and players but innefective against stronger materials.

nodes.name: Flashbang
nodes.desc: A bright explosive device which blinds and disorients anyone near it upon detonation

nodes.name: Mounted Ballista
nodes.desc: A ballista mounted on wheels, designed for mobility and capable of firing bolts at distant targets. Can be towed by horses.

nodes.name: HV Pistol Ammo
nodes.desc: This ammunition travels faster, resulting in less drop and slightly higher damage when fired over long distances.

nodes.name: Garage Door
nodes.desc: A garage door that rolls up and down.

nodes.name: Handcuffs
nodes.desc: You're under arrest! Use on a surrendering or wounded player to keep them restrained. The wearer is blocked from using or holding items and can be pushed around.

nodes.name: Ladder Hatch
nodes.desc: A hatch that opens and changes into a ladder.

nodes.name: Locker
nodes.desc: A locker for keeping your clothes and armor safe!

nodes.name: Large Furnace
nodes.desc: Used to smelt large quantities of ore. Difficult to secure, must be placed on terrain.

nodes.name: Chainsaw
nodes.desc: A Chainsaw. Very effective at cutting trees in addition to soft fleshy objects. Requires Low Grade Fuel to run.

nodes.name: Cooking Workbench
nodes.desc: Used to cook advanced recipes for food, fuel, ammunition and explosives.

nodes.name: Small Oil Refinery
nodes.desc: A small refinery which can produce Low Grade Fuel from Crude Oil.

nodes.name: High External Stone Wall
nodes.desc: A high stone wall used to keep people off your property.

nodes.name: High External Stone Gate
nodes.desc: A high stone gate, allowing access in and out of your compound.

nodes.name: Triangle Ladder Hatch
nodes.desc: A hatch that opens and changes into a ladder.

nodes.name: Heavy Plate Pants
nodes.desc: Offers superior protection at the cost of reduced movement speed.

nodes.name: Heavy Plate Jacket
nodes.desc: Offers superior protection at the cost of aiming down sights and reduced movement speed.

nodes.name: Heavy Plate Helmet
nodes.desc: Offers superior protection at the cost of reduced vision and movement speed.

nodes.name: Night Vision Goggles
nodes.desc: Enables vision at nighttime by projecting and amplifying infrared light.The batteries can be recharged at a Lvl 2 workbench. Cannot be worn with a helmet.

nodes.name: Parachute
nodes.desc: Once equipped, press [+jump] while in mid-air to pull the cord. Must be repacked after use. Must be at least 15m above the ground in order to deploy.

nodes.name: Diver propulsion vehicle
nodes.desc: A personal underwater propulsion device

nodes.name: Asbestos Armor Insert
nodes.desc: Asbestos insert providing extra protection from heat for crafted clothes and armor.

nodes.name: Lead Armor Insert
nodes.desc: Lead insert that adds radiation protection for crafted clothes and armor.

nodes.name: Roadsign Horse Armor
nodes.desc: A full body armor for a horse. Provides strong protection for you and your steed, at the cost of greatly reduced movement speed.

nodes.name: High Quality Horse Shoes
nodes.desc: Equipping these horse shoes will grant your horse additional movement speed

nodes.name: Bee Catapult Bomb
nodes.desc: A bunch of Bee Grenades in a single catapult projectile. Creates swarms of Bees on impact.

nodes.name: Piercer Bolt
nodes.desc: A piercing bolt for a ballista, capable of penetrating armored vehicles.

nodes.name: Incendiary Bolt
nodes.desc: A fire-tipped bolt for a ballista, wrapped in burning cloth, ignites upon impact.

nodes.name: Hammerhead Bolt
nodes.desc: Heavy and solid bolt for a ballista, designed to hammer through doors.

nodes.name: Smoke Grenade
nodes.desc: Produces a large cloud of opaque greyish white smoke.

nodes.name: Propane Explosive Bomb
nodes.desc: An explosive propane-filled keg, devastating to structures. Can be placed or used as a projectile in a catapult.

nodes.name: Semi-Automatic Rifle
nodes.desc: A Semi Automatic Rifle.

nodes.name: Holosight
nodes.desc: Uses laser projection to create a holographic sight which is always pointing at the target regardless of view angle.

nodes.name: Extended Magazine
nodes.desc: Larger magazine size

nodes.name: Targeting Attachment
nodes.desc: An internal weapon mod that allows the user to send pings to their team while the weapon is equipped.

nodes.name: Gas Compression Overdrive
nodes.desc: An internal weapon mod which compresses and directs gasses used for cycling the weapon to the barrel, effectively increasing projectile velocity and damage at the expense of cycle rate.

nodes.name: Rocket Launcher
nodes.desc: Unmatched craftsmanship meets devastating firepower.

nodes.name: High Velocity Rocket
nodes.desc: Fast moving rocket ammunition. Short to medium range self-propelled, unguided rocket which deals large splash damage on impact but less damage than a normal rocket.

nodes.name: SAM Ammo
nodes.desc: Ammunition for a SAM Site. This missile contains a rudimentary guidance system to help it navigate through strong winds.

nodes.name: Incendiary Rocket
nodes.desc: Creates flames upon impact.

nodes.name: Torpedo
nodes.desc: A torpedo for use in a submarine. Fires ahead in a straight line.

nodes.name: Homing Missile Launcher
nodes.desc: An active-guidance homing missile launcher. Once launched, the target must be tracked by the launcher until impact. Can be distracted by flares.

nodes.name: Homing Missile
nodes.desc: Fast moving rocket ammunition. Uses a type of radar for active target guidance from a Homing Launcher

nodes.name: Small Boat Engine
nodes.desc: A punchy boat engine made from scavenged parts, not good for the environment. More engines means more speed.

nodes.name: Incendiary Pistol Bullet
nodes.desc: Slower moving ammunition that deals fire damage. There's a small chance it will start a fire.

nodes.name: 5.56 Rifle Ammo
nodes.desc: Ammunition for a Rifle. Loses velocity when fired over long distances resulting in slightly decreased damage.

nodes.name: High Caliber Revolver
nodes.desc: High Caliber Revolver

nodes.name: Mortar Shell
nodes.desc: A high explosive mortar shell that deals minor structural damage on impact.

nodes.name: Fragmentation Mortar Shell
nodes.desc: A fragmentation mortar shell, dealing lethal damage in a large area on impact.

nodes.name: Mortar
nodes.desc: The Mortar fires in an arcing trajectory and favors volume over precision. Pairs well with binoculars.

nodes.name: Reinforced Glass Window
nodes.desc: Window bars to fit a standard window. These bars are made out of reinforced metal and contain a thick surround to protect from incoming projectiles.

nodes.name: HV 5.56 Rifle Ammo
nodes.desc: This ammunition travels faster, resulting in less drop and slightly higher damage when fired over long distances.

nodes.name: Incendiary 5.56 Rifle Ammo
nodes.desc: Slower moving ammunition that deals fire damage. There's a small chance it will start a fire.

nodes.name: MP5A4
nodes.desc: A medium damage machine gun.

nodes.name: SKS
nodes.desc: A Military-Grade Semi Automatic Rifle.

nodes.name: Armored Door
nodes.desc: Extremely strong door with a hatch to see and shoot out of.

nodes.name: Armored Double Door
nodes.desc: Extremely strong door with a hatch to see and shoot out of.

nodes.name: Weapon Lasersight
nodes.desc: Attaches to a weapon. Provides user with a guiding laser and reduces weapon sway.

nodes.name: Metal Chest Plate
nodes.desc: A metal plate covering your torso, provides excellent protection from all forms of attacks.

nodes.name: Explosive 5.56 Rifle Ammo
nodes.desc: This ammo explodes on contact dealing a small amount of fragmentation damage to nearby objects.

nodes.name: Metal Facemask
nodes.desc: A protective facemask which provides the user with excellent head protection from all forms of attacks.

nodes.name: HMLMG
nodes.desc: A hand made belt-fed light machine gun with high damage, high rate of fire, low accuracy during short bursts.

nodes.name: Assault Rifle
nodes.desc: High damage machine rifle.

nodes.name: Bolt Action Rifle
nodes.desc: A High powered, highly accurate, long range rifle.

nodes.name: 8x Zoom Scope
nodes.desc: A small 8x zoom scope.

nodes.name: Timed Explosive Charge
nodes.desc: C4, useful for breaking into bases.

nodes.name: Rocket
nodes.desc: Ammunition for a Rocket Launcher. A short to medium range self-propelled, unguided rocket which deals large splash damage on impact.

nodes.name: Explosives
nodes.desc: A component used for crafting C4 and Rockets.

nodes.name: Armored Ladder Hatch
nodes.desc: An armored hatch that opens and changes into a ladder.

nodes.name: Armored Triangle Ladder Hatch
nodes.desc: A triangular armored hatch that opens and changes into a ladder.

nodes.name: Switch
nodes.desc: A simple electric switch.

nodes.name: Large Solar Panel
nodes.desc: A solar panel which converts sunlight into energy. The amount of energy generated is dependent on the sun's intensity and angle to the panel.

nodes.name: Small Rechargeable Battery
nodes.desc: A small rechargable battery. Must have a minimum charge of 5 seconds to discharge. Can be wired in series. Charging rate is dependant on power in, with a maximum of 80% efficiency.

nodes.name: Splitter
nodes.desc: Splits an electrical signal into 3 multiple signals. the amount passed through is equal to the input amount divided by the number of used output slots.

nodes.name: Ceiling Light
nodes.desc: A small ceiling mounted light source.

nodes.name: Root Combiner
nodes.desc: This object combines two root electrical sources into a single signal. Helpful for stringing together low energy batteries or solar panels to produce higher power output. Can be wired in series, can not be used with any non energy producing electrical components.

nodes.name: Metal Detector
nodes.desc: Detects metal objects which may otherwise be hidden. When the light flashes, or you hear a beep, aim to search for items. Increase the bar until a flag appears. Dig at the flag with a melee item to reveal what it is. Different areas yield different rewards

nodes.name: Electrical Branch
nodes.desc: This object allows you to branch power off from a main line by a set amount.

nodes.name: Timer
nodes.desc: A Timer switch, will pass power through for duration.

nodes.name: Flasher Light
nodes.desc: A flashing blue light

nodes.name: Siren Light
nodes.desc: A spinning siren light

nodes.name: Audio Alarm
nodes.desc: A speaker which will emit a loud warning alarm when powered

nodes.name: Search Light
nodes.desc: A Large, wide beam, aimable light source.

nodes.name: Pressure Pad
nodes.desc: A gate which allows power to flow while a player is standing on it

nodes.name: Door Controller
nodes.desc: A Door Controller. Will manipulate the state of the closest door when it receives power

nodes.name: Telephone
nodes.desc: Use the telephone to call other telephones on the island!

nodes.name: Digital Clock
nodes.desc: A digital clock that displays the server time and lets you set alarms to pass power through when ringing. Ideal for synchronizing traps or timed events.

nodes.name: Button
nodes.desc: A simple electric button.

nodes.name: Igniter
nodes.desc: Ignites nearby objects such as furnaces and campfires when power is received

nodes.name: Reactive Target
nodes.desc: A reactive target that knocks down when hit, can be reset.

nodes.name: Counter
nodes.desc: A basic cathode ray tube screen combined with an incremental counter. Can display power received, or can count upwards and allow passthrough when a target is reached.

nodes.name: HBHF Sensor
nodes.desc: A Heartbeat, Breathing, Humidity and Footstep sensor. Passthrough is equal to the number of humans detected in a 10m radius

nodes.name: Seismic Sensor
nodes.desc: A small device that detects vibrations within a set range. Will output a different power value depending on the explosive type detected, ideal to know when your time has come.

nodes.name: Electric Heater
nodes.desc: Provides warmth in a radius when on

nodes.name: Laser Detector
nodes.desc: A gate which allows power to flow while a player is in the beam

nodes.name: Water Barrel
nodes.desc: A storage container for water. Can output 10ml of water a second via a hose.

nodes.name: Sprinkler
nodes.desc: A small sprinkler that sprays water around it. Requires a hose connection to supply it with water.

nodes.name: Fluid Combiner
nodes.desc: Combines three separate fluid connections into one connection.

nodes.name: Fluid Splitter
nodes.desc: Splits a fluid connection into three separate connections.

nodes.name: Small Water Catcher
nodes.desc: Collects drinkable water from the air via rain and dew. Can be connected to other entities to provide water, 20ml a second.

nodes.name: Modular Car Lift
nodes.desc: This allows you to modify modular vehicles

nodes.name: Cockpit Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module cockpit for a driver and one passenger.

nodes.name: Flatbed Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module flatbed.

nodes.name: Cockpit With Engine Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module cockpit for a driver and one passenger, with a small engine.

nodes.name: Large Flatbed Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Dual module large flatbed.

nodes.name: Fuel Tank Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Dual module large fuel tank.

nodes.name: Storage Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module storage.

nodes.name: Rear Seats Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module seating for two passengers.

nodes.name: Low Quality Carburetor
nodes.desc: A low quality carburetor for a combustion engine. Mixes air and fuel to the proper ratio.

nodes.name: Passenger Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Dual module seating.

nodes.name: Medium Quality Carburetor
nodes.desc: A medium quality carburetor for a combustion engine. Mixes air and fuel to the proper ratio.

nodes.name: Taxi Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module seating for two passengers, with protection at the front.

nodes.name: Armored Passenger Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module armored seating for two passengers.

nodes.name: High Quality Carburetor
nodes.desc: A high quality carburetor for a combustion engine. Mixes air and fuel to the proper ratio.

nodes.name: Medium Quality Crankshaft
nodes.desc: A medium quality crankshaft for a combustion engine. Converts piston movement into rotational motion.

nodes.name: High Quality Crankshaft
nodes.desc: A high quality crankshaft for a combustion engine. Converts piston movement into rotational motion.

nodes.name: Low Quality Pistons
nodes.desc: Low quality pistons for a combustion engine. Pistons convert expanding combustion gases into the motion that turns a crankshaft.

nodes.name: Low Quality Spark Plugs
nodes.desc: Low quality spark plugs for a combustion engine. Spark plugs ignite the fuel/air mixture to move the pistons.

nodes.name: Low Quality Valves
nodes.desc: Low quality poppet valves for a combustion engine. Valves control the intake and exhaust flow.

nodes.name: Medium Quality Valves
nodes.desc: Medium quality poppet valves for a combustion engine. Valves control the intake and exhaust flow.

nodes.name: Medium Quality Spark Plugs
nodes.desc: Medium quality spark plugs for a combustion engine. Spark plugs ignite the fuel/air mixture to move the pistons.

nodes.name: Medium Quality Pistons
nodes.desc: Medium quality pistons for a combustion engine. Pistons convert expanding combustion gases into the motion that turns a crankshaft.

nodes.name: High Quality Pistons
nodes.desc: High quality pistons for a combustion engine. Pistons convert expanding combustion gases into the motion that turns a crankshaft.

nodes.name: High Quality Spark Plugs
nodes.desc: High quality spark plugs for a combustion engine. Spark plugs ignite the fuel/air mixture to move the pistons.

nodes.name: High Quality Valves
nodes.desc: High quality poppet valves for a combustion engine. Valves control the intake and exhaust flow.

nodes.name: Engine Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module large engine.

nodes.name: Low Quality Crankshaft
nodes.desc: A low quality crankshaft for a combustion engine. Converts piston movement into rotational motion.

nodes.name: Armored Cockpit Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Single module armored cockpit for a driver and one passenger.

nodes.name: Fluid Switch & Pump
nodes.desc: A simple switch that enables fluid to pass through. Can be switched on/off manually or via electricity. Can also pump water upwards to higher entities when powered.

nodes.name: Large Water Catcher
nodes.desc: Collects drinkable water from the air via rain and dew. Can be connected to other entities to provide water, 20ml a second.

nodes.name: Powered Water Purifier
nodes.desc: A device that converts salt water to fresh water while powered.

nodes.name: Water Pump
nodes.desc: Can be placed in a water source to collect that water while powered. Can be connected to other Water entities.

nodes.name: Mini Fridge
nodes.desc: Ideal for preserving food and keeping items cool.

nodes.name: Camper Vehicle Module
nodes.desc: Dual module camper that allows up to 4 players to respawn. Also includes a barbecue, a locker and a small box for item storage.

nodes.name: Blocker
nodes.desc: This object prevents passthrough while power is received through its second input.

nodes.name: OR Switch
nodes.desc: A logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if EITHER input receives power, passthrough amount is the greater of either power source

nodes.name: XOR Switch
nodes.desc: An exclusive-or logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if ONLY ONE input receives power, passthrough amount is whichever single input is active. If BOTH inputs receive power, passthrough will be zero.

nodes.name: Medium Rechargeable Battery
nodes.desc: A Medium Rechargable Battery. Must have a minimum charge of 5 seconds to discharge. Can be wired in series. Charging rate is dependant on power in, with a maximum of 80% efficiency.

nodes.name: Small Generator
nodes.desc: A small electric generator powered by Low Grade Fuel that outputs 40 power.

nodes.name: RF Pager
nodes.desc: An RF Pager. An audible tone will be produced when a signal is picked up on the listening frequency. Can be set to silent mode.

nodes.name: RAND Switch
nodes.desc: This switch will allow passthrough based on a random number. Each time the SET input receives power it will roll true or false to allow passthrough

nodes.name: Smart Alarm
nodes.desc: Sends a notifications to your phone when powered on.

nodes.name: RF Broadcaster
nodes.desc: An RF Broadcaster

nodes.name: RF Receiver
nodes.desc: An RF Receiver

nodes.name: Storage Monitor
nodes.desc: The Storage Monitor attaches to the Tool Cupboard and Large Storage Box to monitor the container contents. Output sends a pulse when the container is updated.

nodes.name: RF Transmitter
nodes.desc: A hand held RF signal broadcaster. Left click to broadcast. Configurable with right mouse.

nodes.name: Smart Switch
nodes.desc: A smart electric switch.

nodes.name: AND Switch
nodes.desc: A logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if BOTH inputs receives power, passthrough amount is the greater of either power source

nodes.name: Memory Cell
nodes.desc: A 1 bit storage component. SET input will set the value to 1 CLEAR input sets the value to 0. Output will provide connected power if value is 1, Inverted output will provide connected power if value is 0. This is also known as a D-Type Flip Flop

nodes.name: Computer Station
nodes.desc: A Computer station for remote control access

nodes.name: Tesla Coil
nodes.desc: An electrical trap that zaps nearby players when powered. More power supplied will result in higher damage. Loses durability with use.

nodes.name: Drone
nodes.desc: A remote controlled drone operated from the Computer station with a limited range. Easily damaged from impacts.

nodes.name: PTZ CCTV Camera
nodes.desc: A CCTV Camera system can be used for realtime surveillance and security when paired with the Computer Station. This camera has pan, tilt, and zoom capability.

nodes.name: Wind Turbine
nodes.desc: Converts kinetic energy harvested from the wind into electricity. Amount generated will vary depending on wind speed. Higher altitudes will yield stronger winds.

nodes.name: Large Rechargeable Battery
nodes.desc: A Large Rechargeable Battery. Must have a minimum charge of 5 seconds to discharge. Can be wired in series. Charging rate is dependant on power in, with a maximum of 80% efficiency.

nodes.name: Auto Turret
nodes.desc: This automated electric sentry turret will engage and neutralize any moving targets it has line of sight to. You must equip it with a projectile weapon and the corresponding ammunition. Note : The turret will search for targets in a 180 degree arc facing *you* when you place it. Requires 10 power.

nodes.name: Elevator
nodes.desc: A powered elevator. Place another elevator above or below this to connect it. Requires power.

nodes.name: Electric Furnace
nodes.desc: An electrical version of a furnace that uses electricity instead of a fuel source.

nodes.name: Industrial Conveyor
nodes.desc: Moves an item from one container to another.

nodes.name: Industrial Combiner
nodes.desc: Combines three separate industrial connections into one connection.

nodes.name: Industrial Crafter
nodes.desc: Attaches to a workbench to allow automated crafting.

nodes.name: Hopper
nodes.desc: Will suck up any dropped items in it's radius while powered

nodes.name: Industrial Splitter
nodes.desc: Splits an industrial connection into three separate connections.

nodes.name: Storage Adaptor
nodes.desc: Attach to a storage container to allow industrial input/output connections.

nodes.name: Fridge
nodes.desc: A fridge you can store food into!

nodes.name: Water Wheel
nodes.desc: Converts kinetic energy harvested from flowing water into electricity.
